_manual_note: Manual says FabLink creates standard report definitions at startup; this file defines additional runtime reports.
description: DaVinci 200 MC4 HC1 curated event subscription. Every collection event the canonical mapper categorizes (lot/wafer/carrier/process/job/alarm/material lifecycle) is subscribed, so no 'unknown' telemetry is published. Events without valid variables are enabled with no report link (an empty RPTID list would delete the link). Full superset kept in EventSubscription.full.json; to capture more, add aliases in profiles.py:DAVINCI_CEID_ALIASES and re-curate, or point the profile at EventSubscription.full.json.
